in_sanskrit.name: एकदन्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ekdant in Sanskrit is derived from the words 'Eka' which means One and 'Danta' which means Tooth. This name signifies someone who has only one tooth, often in the context of the mythological figure of Lord Ganesha who has an elephant head with only one tusk.

in_hindi.name: एकदन्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Ekdant in Hindi is derived from the words 'Ek' which means One and 'Dant' which means Tooth. This name signifies someone who has only one tooth.

in_tamil.name: ஐக்கதந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Ekdant in Tamil is derived from the words 'Oikku' which means One and 'Tanthiram' which means Tooth. This name signifies someone who has only one tooth.

in_telugu.name: ఏకదంత
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Ekdant in Telugu is derived from the words 'Ekko' which means One and 'Dantamu' which means Tooth. This name signifies someone who has only one tooth.

in_marathi.name: Ekdant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekdant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Refers to Lord Ganesha, who is depicted with only one tusk. Symbolizes wisdom, courage, and the ability to overcome obstacles.

in_bengali.name: Ekdant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ekdant একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Refers to Lord Ganesha, who is depicted with only one tusk. Symbolizes wisdom, courage, and the ability to overcome obstacles.
